summary: A large review count and a multi doctor team are strengths, but leaked form text, repeated reviews and blank images appear to weaken the page.

findings.problem: Both Treatments menu items link to #, and ENQUIRE NOW and View Map use popup anchors instead of real pages.
findings.cost: Visitors cannot browse treatments from the main menu.

findings.problem: The callback form shows This field is for validation purposes and should be left unchanged, plus a stray symbol and a lone First label.
findings.cost: Leftover form text looks unfinished at the point of enquiry.

findings.problem: The review block appears twice, with the same reviews shown under first names and then full names, and about 25 images appear to be blank placeholders.
findings.cost: Repeated reviews and blank images look like an error.
findings.fix: One review wall and real images.

findings.problem: Saturday hours read 9am to 6pm in the body and 9am to 7pm in the footer, and doctor names vary between reviews and the doctor list.
findings.cost: Mixed details cause confusion and missed visits.
findings.fix: One verified set of hours and names.

redesign: Working menus and a clean enquiry form with WhatsApp.
One review wall and real images.
Consistent hours and doctor names across the site.
